blind_spots: Intraprocedural location href/search/hash sources only; not framework-wide XSS coverage.
Only imported default sanitize-html calls without options are sanitizers. Local bindings and function/arrow parameters are excluded; complex rebinding or wrapper semantics require review.
Other sanitizers are intentionally not trusted and may produce false positives.
Intraprocedural URL sources and named eval/Function/string timer sinks only; not arbitrary dynamic-code coverage.

rules.family: HTTP request to Node shell execution
blind_spots: Sources are query/body/params on identifiers named req or request; framework wrappers and differently named request objects are not covered.
Intraprocedural child_process exec/execSync, selected shell:true APIs and sh/bash/dash/zsh -c forms only; import/require wrappers and alternative shell switches may be missed.
Argument arrays without shell execution are intentionally not sinks; candidates still require verification of input control and quoting.
Literal rejectUnauthorized:false option objects flowing into known HTTPS/TLS APIs only; environment overrides, property mutations and third-party clients are not covered.
node: import forms are explicitly tested for namespace HTTPS and named TLS connect; other import/require wrappers may be missed.
TLS usage context and compensating custom verification still require source review.

rules.family: External input to Python subprocess shell
blind_spots: Intraprocedural Flask args/form/json, sys.argv and input sources with explicit shell=True on subprocess APIs only.
Other web frameworks, indirect option dictionaries and shell wrappers are not covered; quoting and actual attacker control require review.
Requests module calls and locally constructed Session calls with explicit verify=False, including constant aliases; session property changes and wrapper functions are not covered.
unsafe_load/unsafe_load_all and explicit Loader/UnsafeLoader/CLoader/CUnsafeLoader forms; local loader assignment support is bounded to UnsafeLoader with yaml.load.
Loader omission, FullLoader version-specific issues, customized SafeLoader constructors and wrapper APIs are not covered.
A dangerous loader is a candidate configuration; untrusted YAML reachability is not proven.
crypto/tls.Config composite literals with InsecureSkipVerify:true only; field assignments and nonliteral booleans are not covered.
Custom VerifyConnection/VerifyPeerCertificate callbacks can provide verification and require source review.

rules.family: Go HTTP request to shell execution
blind_spots: Intraprocedural named functions with *http.Request parameters and Query().Get/FormValue/PostFormValue/Header.Get sources only.
exec.Command/CommandContext with sh/bash/dash/zsh -c only; handlers wrapped in closures, alternative shells and interprocedural flows are not covered.
Intraprocedural Reqwest Client::builder/ClientBuilder::new flows to literal true danger_accept_invalid_certs/hostnames calls, including blocking clients.
Builder parameters, factory wrappers, type aliases and nonliteral flags may be missed; arbitrary similarly named methods are not assumed to be Reqwest.
Heuristic candidate only, not an exploit claim: format! output may contain trusted values or safely constrained identifiers.

Intraprocedural format! flows to sqlx::query and two-type-parameter query_as/query_scalar calls only; SQLx compile-time query macros, concatenation, other formatting APIs and interprocedural flows are not covered.
Static parameterized queries with bind are negative controls; bind does not repair SQL structure already interpolated by format!.
